reason: Open redirect through a backslash in a navigation target. Fixed only in react-router 7, a major upgrade of the console and the website. The console never navigates to a caller-supplied address: returnTo is checked against its own route table (safeReturn). Remove this when the router is upgraded.

Affects server-side rendering hydration (deserializeErrors). Neither the console nor the website renders on a server: both are static client builds. Fixed only in react-router 7. Remove this when the router is upgraded.
